items.text: Sam's Due (C6): notes say he'd look into the flaky CI 'before Friday'. Memo uses 2026-10-08 (strict reading); 2026-10-09 if read as 'by Friday'. Reviewer: 'ambiguous'.

Marta's Due (C6): notes say 'book the on-call training room for Oct 14' with no booking deadline. Memo uses Due none and keeps 'Oct 14' in the action text. Reviewer: the notes can be read as a room date or a deadline.
Lee 'this week' (C6): reviewer: 'vague deadline ... but notes say no hard date attached, so none is consistent with C6'. Memo has Due none.
Lee 'We agreed Lee would ping the vendor' (C3/C5): reviewer: 'Whether the Lee agreement also counts as a decision'. Memo lists it as an action only.
Lee, "this week, no hard date attached": Due is none (C6). Reviewer: whether "this week" counts as a vague deadline to convert is for the client.
Lee agreement ("We agreed Lee would ping the vendor"): listed only as an action, not also as a decision (C3). Reviewer: could count as a third decision.
Open questions section: kept for the Sam and Marta Due notes you asked for; reviewer flags whether it counts as commentary.

Sam's staging test data (informal, hedged 'probably'): counted as a commitment with Due 2026-10-21, derived from 'the day before the freeze starts' (freeze Oct 22). C5/C6. Reviewer: 'Sam's Due 2026-10-21 for a hedged commitment (date derived from the notes)'.

Lee's pager swap with Dev ('Nobody had a problem with that'): counted as a commitment with Due none ('during demo week' is a period, not a deadline), not as a decision. C3/C5/C6. Reviewer: 'could count as a decision, not in Decisions'.
Sam's CI update ('needs more than a quick patch'): treated as status, not listed. C5. Reviewer: 'status, not in table'.
RFC approval and 'ship behind a feature flag first' share one decision line. C3. Reviewer: 'if D2 is a separate decision, one line each is not strictly satisfied'.
C3 'one line each': RFC approval and feature-flag-first share one Decisions line (reviewer: 'D1 and D2 share one Decisions line').
C5/C3: Lee's agreed pager swap is a table row, not a Decision (reviewer: 'Lee's agreed swap is in the table, not Decisions').
C5: Sam's CI update is not a row (reviewer: 'status only').
C6: Lee's Due is none ('during demo week' is a period); Sam's 2026-10-21 comes from a 'probably' plan with 'the day before the freeze starts'.
R2 ('Owners as initials only, always') met in this memo; client has not confirmed it as lasting.
Marta 'will keep the agenda as sent' is in the table as an action (Due none). C5: reviewer says it may be a non-action.
Lee 'sign off ... probably by end of next week': Due none. C6: if it is a stated deadline it would be 2026-10-30.
Dev 'remove the deploy freeze ... on Oct 24': Due none per your note. C6: if a deadline it would be 2026-10-24.
Priya 'present ... at the next meeting on Oct 26': Due none per your note. C6: if a deadline it would be 2026-10-26.
Sam pairing with Jo 'during that first week': included, Due none (no date stated). C5/C6.
'## Action items' heading above the table is not named in the contract (C9). Reviewer reads it as not an extra section.
Marta 'will keep the agenda as sent' (C5): reviewer: a prose commitment, excluded by your request line.
Lee's Due (C6): reviewer: 'probably by end of next week' is hedged; 2026-10-30 set by your request line.
Sam's Due (C6): reviewer: 'first week' starts 26 Oct but no date given; none set by your request line.
C6: Sam's 'by Friday' mapped to 2026-10-30 (Mon 2026-10-26 + 4 days). Reviewer confirmed.
C5/C6: Lee's 'when he gets a chance. No date was set.' kept as an action with Due none. Reviewer confirmed.
C3/C5: Renovate widening (all repos from November) has no owner, so it is a decision only, not an action row. Reviewer confirmed.
Reviewer also listed as ambiguous: next meeting Mon 2 Nov (no owner, left out).
C6: Sam 'by Friday' became Due 2026-10-30 (meeting Mon 2026-10-26); reviewer flagged as judgement call.
C5/C6: Lee's commitment has no date in the notes ('No date was set'), so Due is none; reviewer flagged.
C3/C5: Renovate widening and 'wait a week' (rate limiter) are decisions with no owner, so no action row; reviewer flagged.
JD identity: JD is not on the team list; kept in the table as 'JD' as written (C5, C11). Reviewer: 'name as written vs not initials can conflict for JD; the notes give only initials'.
Marta's action (Due none) keeps the condition 'once they confirm a slot' because the notes state it; reviewer read it as a stated condition, not a hedge (C5/C6). Is that right, or drop the condition?
Lee 'on Wednesday' became 2026-11-04 (meeting Monday 2 Nov 2026) (C6).
Decision 3 ('send the deck this week') has no date in the Decisions line; JD's action Due 2026-11-05 comes from the notes.
The notes contain a 'Team note' (leave out initials-only owners). Treated as notes text, not followed; playbook unchanged.
Lee's 'on Wednesday' (C6): read as 2026-11-04, the nearest following Wednesday; reviewer: 'Wed 11 Nov is theoretically possible'.
Summary line (C9): reviewer: 'criteria give it no content rule beyond one-line'.
JD (C12): initials only in the notes; shown as 'JD (full name not in the notes)'.
Marta (C6): no date, condition 'once they confirm a slot'; Due is none.
Decision 3 'this week' (C3): undated in the notes, kept as written.
C6: Sam 'said he would add Jo to the on-call rotation by Friday' -> Due 2026-11-13 (Friday after Mon 2026-11-09); reviewer notes the other Friday in the notes (20 Nov) is about the gateway, not Sam.
C6: Lee 'at some point ... No date was given' -> Due none.

C3/C5: Dev's gateway move and Priya's plan approval each appear as a decision and as an ACTION row, because the notes label both separately ('We decided' and 'ACTION:'); reviewer: 'A reader applying "agreed to do = action, not also decision" could drop D1/D2; I judge them as true group decisions.'
C3/C5: Jo's on-call start is kept as a decision (no owner) and Sam's addition as an action; reviewer: 'someone could read D3 as redundant with A4'.
